players.bio: Andrija Maksimović (born 5 June 2007) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Serbia national team.
Antonio Eromonsele Nordby Nusa (born 17 April 2005) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays for German Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Norway national team.
Forzan Assan Ouédraogo (born 9 May 2006) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.
Benjamin Paa Kwesi Henrichs (born 23 February 1997) is a German professional footballer who plays as a full-back or midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.

Brajan Gruda is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig, on loan from Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion, and the Germany national under-21 football team. Born in Speyer, Gruda began his career with local side FV Speyer, before joining Karlsruher SC in 2015.
Castello Junior Lukeba, also known as Castello Jr. (born 17 December 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the France national team.
Christoph Baumgartner (born 1 August 1999) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a attacking midfielder and forward for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Austria national team.

Christopher Alan Nkunku (born 14 November 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig, on loan from Serie A club AC Milan, and the France national team. Nkunku is a graduate of the Paris Saint-Germain Academy and made his professional debut for the club in December 2015.
David Raum (born 22 April 1998) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or left back for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Germany national team.
Ezechiel Banzuzi (born 16 February 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.
Saint-Cyr Johan Bakayoko is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for German Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Belgium national team.
Kevin Kampl (born 9 October 1990) is a Slovenian footballer who plays as a midfielder for the Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.
Leopold Zingerle (born 10 April 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.
Lukas Manuel Klostermann (born 3 June 1996) is a German footballer who plays as a defender for RB Leipzig.
Marc Guiu Paz (born 4 January 2006) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.

Martín Gastón Demichelis (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 20 December 1980) is an Argentine football manager and former player who is the head coach of club RB Leipzig. Demichelis spent most of his professional career with Bayern Munich in Germany (seven and a half years), winning 11 major titles with the team.
Max Finkgräfe (born 27 March 2004) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig

Maxime Fernand Christian Estève is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig. Career A youth product of Montpellier, Estève signed his first aspirant contract with the club on 19 November 2019. He made his professional debut with Montpellier in a 3–2 Ligue 1 loss to Olympique de Marseille 8 August 2021.

Nicolas Seiwald (born 4 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Austria national team. Seiwald began his career in 2009 with the youth academy of FC Red Bull Salzburg. He made his professional debut playing for Red Bull Salzburg's feeder team, Liefering, against WSG Wattens on 24 May 2019.

Ørjan Håskjold Nyland (born 10 September 1990) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Sevilla and the Norway national team. Nyland previously played for Hødd and was the man of the match in the 2012 Norwegian Football Cup Final. He joined the defending Tippeligaen champions Molde ahead of the 2013 season.

Bote Ridle Nzuzi Baku (born Bote Nzuzi Baku; 8 April 1998) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right-back, winger or midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Germany national team.

Rocco Reitz (born 29 May 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as an defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach. Reitz made his professional debut for Borussia Mönchengladbach in the Bundesliga on 24 October 2020, starting in the away match against Mainz 05 before being substituted out in the 60th minute for Jonas Hofmann.
Rômulo José Cardoso da Cruz (born 8 February 2002), known as Rômulo Cardoso or just Rômulo, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.
Tidiam Diadie Stephan Gomis (born 8 August 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for German Bundesliga club RB Leipzig.
Vilmos Tamás "Willi" Orbán (born 3 November 1992) is a German-born Hungarian professional footballer who captains Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and plays for the Hungary national team as a centre back.
